messages:
sam_finance: FYI — spotted a recurring pattern of delayed metering ingestion over the past two weeks. This is causing late token tallies and a handful of invoice corrections. quick summary + proposed owners below. link: https://redwood.company/ops/postmortem/meters-2026 (notes)
maria_product: Ack. Can you paste the minimal evidence here? I want to know which customers are impacted and whether this is a single pipeline or multiple.
devon_eng: Short version: ingestion lag in the lambda -> kafka consumer group when consumer instances hit backpressure after the 2026-03-11 routing change. Queryed daily deltas:
```
-- gap by day
SELECT day, sum(tokens_ingested) AS ingested, sum(tokens_expected) AS expected, sum(tokens_ingested)-sum(tokens_expected) AS delta
FROM metering.tokens
WHERE day BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-18'
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY day;
```
We see dips on 2026-03-12 and 2026-03-15; subsequent backfill ran but some shards missed due to consumer restart window.
jin_sre: There were multiple autorestarts on 2026-03-12 03:10-03:22 UTC (kube pod OOMs) after the routing rollout. I logged events: ``Pod/meters-consumer-5 Restarted (OOMKilled) x3``. Rolling window overlapped with peak ingestion. Putting that here in case it matters.
nish_billing: Which accounts do we need to credit? Last invoice run touched ~12k customers; I assume only a small subset saw measurable undercount.
sam_finance: I pulled customers with >1k token delta between expected and final billed counts: [acme, bluewave, edu-platform, statly]. Will attach csv to the internal drive. Suggest provisional credits for March invoices; final amounts after backfill completes.
maria_product: Proposal: short-term mitigation + permanent fix. Who owns what? Need owners and dates so we can communicate to sales/CS.
devon_eng: Proposed actions (short and long):\nA1: Backfill re-run with widened shard window (short-term) — owner: devon_eng — due: 2026-03-22
A2: Temporary autoscale guardrail rollback to pre-2026-03-11 settings (prevent consumer OOMs) — owner: jin_sre — due: 2026-03-21
A3: Billing credits list and customer comms draft — owner: sam_finance + nish_billing — due: 2026-03-23
A4: Add end-to-end metering regression test + spike protection (long-term) — owner: devon_eng + eng-platform — due: 2026-04-05
I can kick off A1 now; backfill ETA ~3-4 hours depending on shard retries.
metering-bot: [automated] Backfill job MET-BACKFILL-879 queued by devon_eng at 2026-03-20T15:02Z. Estimated runtime: 3h.
jin_sre: I'll roll the autoscale rollback to canary now, monitor for pod OOMs, and keep you posted. If stable after 2 hours I'll roll cluster-wide.
sam_finance: For transparency: we should track remediation state in one place. I'll create a tracking doc and a single tracking ticket. Also recommend a short postmortem session Thurs 2026-03-24 10:00 PT (30m).
maria_product: :thumbsup: Please add the customer list to the ticket and tag CS + sales for comms.
devon_eng: Created ticket MET-7421 with the A1/A4 tasks and linked invoices CSV. Will update with backfill completion time.
jin_sre: Autoscale rollback canary looks stable after 45m. No new OOMs in that window. Rolling to remaining clusters now.
sam_finance: Noted. After backfill completes, let's reconvene to confirm delta resolved and finalize credits. If we still see residual gaps we'll open recurrence investigation (pattern detection across deploys).
nish_billing: I'll prepare the provisional credit memos and get sign-off from finance ops. ETA for comms draft: 2026-03-23 EOD.
metering-bot: [automated] Backfill job MET-BACKFILL-879 completed at 2026-03-20T18:28Z. Rows processed: 2,128,431. Missed shards retried: 2.
devon_eng: Backfill results look good at a glance; spot-checking customer deltas now. If everything aligns with expected counts we'll mark A1 Done.
maria_product: Booking postmortem on Thu 2026-03-24 10:00 PT. Invite: #product, #eng, #sre, #finance, #cs.
sam_finance: Thanks everyone. I'll keep the tracking doc updated; putting owners on the items as discussed. Follow-ups if anything regresses.
